prepSteps.title: Create a Wiz service account
prepSteps.instruction: In Wiz, create a service account with read:data_findings, create:reports, and read:reports, then copy Client ID and Client Secret into the operator vault.
prepSteps.evidence: Wiz lists the Entro service account (secret stored outside the session)
